units.source_text: 鸨母顽固地将敦实的后背向着传来笑声的方向。

en.t: The madam stubbornly turned her solid back toward the direction from which the laughter came.

units.source_text: 让我去的那间小客厅，是一间煞风景的三铺席宽的房间，

en.t: The small sitting room into which I was shown was a dreary room about three tatami mats wide,

units.source_text: 里面好像是用洗涮茶具的地方充做壁龛，壁龛里随便地摆着布袋神像和招财猫。

en.t: inside, a place for washing tea utensils seemed to have been used as an alcove, where a statue of Hotei and a beckoning cat had been set down carelessly.

units.source_text: 墙上贴着一张小条子和挂着一份日历。

en.t: A small slip of paper was pasted on the wall, and a calendar was hanging there.

units.source_text: 悬吊着一盏三四十支光的昏暗的灯。

en.t: A dim lamp of thirty or forty watts hung suspended from above.

units.source_text: 从敞开的窗扉传来了外面的嫖客稀疏的脚步声。

en.t: Through the open window came the sparse footsteps of customers outside.
